================================================================================
Slash-tailed operator names (sloplint SC-OPSLASH)
================================================================================

trait Foldable[F[_]] {
  def /:/[B](b: B)(f: (B, B) => B): B
  def |/[B](b: B): B
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
  (trait_definition
    name: (identifier)
    type_parameters: (type_parameters
      name: (identifier)
      type_parameters: (type_parameters
        name: (wildcard)))
    body: (template_body
      (function_declaration
        name: (operator_identifier)
        parameters: (type_parameters
          name: (identifier))
        parameters: (parameters
          (parameter
            name: (identifier)
            type: (type_identifier)))
        parameters: (parameters
          (parameter
            name: (identifier)
            type: (function_type
              parameter_types: (parameter_types
                type: (type_identifier)
                type: (type_identifier))
              return_type: (type_identifier))))
        return_type: (type_identifier))
      (function_declaration
        name: (operator_identifier)
        parameters: (type_parameters
          name: (identifier))
        parameters: (parameters
          (parameter
            name: (identifier)
            type: (type_identifier)))
        return_type: (type_identifier)))))

================================================================================
Unparenthesized typed lambda in a case body (sloplint SC-TYPEDLAMBDA)
================================================================================

class W[A](a: A)
object W {
  def m(xs: Any) = xs match {
    case c if classOf[Array[Long]].equals(c) =>
      a: Array[Long] => new W(a)
    case w => w
  }
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
  (class_definition
    name: (identifier)
    type_parameters: (type_parameters
      name: (identifier))
    class_parameters: (class_parameters
      (class_parameter
        name: (identifier)
        type: (type_identifier))))
  (object_definition
    name: (identifier)
    body: (template_body
      (function_definition
        name: (identifier)
        parameters: (parameters
          (parameter
            name: (identifier)
            type: (type_identifier)))
        body: (match_expression
          value: (identifier)
          body: (case_block
            (case_clause
              pattern: (identifier)
              (guard
                condition: (call_expression
                  function: (field_expression
                    value: (generic_function
                      function: (identifier)
                      type_arguments: (type_arguments
                        (generic_type
                          type: (type_identifier)
                          type_arguments: (type_arguments
                            (type_identifier)))))
                    field: (identifier))
                  arguments: (arguments
                    (identifier))))
              body: (lambda_expression
                parameters: (identifier)
                parameters: (generic_type
                  type: (type_identifier)
                  type_arguments: (type_arguments
                    (type_identifier)))
                (instance_expression
                  (type_identifier)
                  arguments: (arguments
                    (identifier)))))
            (case_clause
              pattern: (identifier)
              body: (identifier))))))))
